title: The Conway-Parker algebra and the largest Fischer group
summary: We give a direct, self-contained construction of the three sporadic Fischer groups $\mathrm{Fi}_{24}'$, $\mathrm{Fi}_{23}$, and $\mathrm{Fi}_{22}$ from the $783$-dimensional Conway-Parker algebra. We prove that its distinguished roots define involutory algebra automorphisms whose projective actions generate the full Fischer $3$-transposition group $\mathrm{Fi}_{24}$. Its commutator subgroup gives $\mathrm{Fi}_{24}'$, while $\mathrm{Fi}_{23}$ and $\mathrm{Fi}_{22}$ arise as centralizer quotients associated with one and two commuting transpositions.
